instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only key-to-fill ratio. Set key-to-fill ratio to: strong fill, flat lighting ratio, key still from the same side. Change only fill strength versus key. Keep the key on the same side. Do not rotate the key. Do not harden it into a new sun or window. Do not add lamps, rims, or glowing eyes. Do not add grain, softness, hue, time of day, or a genre.
hold_constant: Change only fill strength versus key. Keep the key on the same side. Do not rotate the key. Do not harden it into a new sun or window. Do not add lamps, rims, or glowing eyes. Do not add grain, softness, hue, time of day, or a genre.
